hypothesis: At fixed patience50, larger H improves T, smaller H>=5 improves D, and F peaks at H5-10; verify model patterns against the same fixed-s5 account rule.
user_authorization: 确定延长早停有效的话，就用该方法重跑H实验
model: M0 single LightGBM; Alpha158+range; original training dates and M0 weights
label_processing: Legacy H40-base sample protocol. H40 ranks before listing-age filter; other H rank on H40-valid/listing-qualified base. Each target then drops its own missing labels; no seven-H intersection.

source_policy.features: Frozen Nov2 pure feature manifest/blocks, common to all H
source_policy.labels: All H and H40 base rebuilt on one frozen Nov3 provider snapshot; preserve original yearly H40 ProcessInf/rank ordering
source_policy.validation: Same exit-bounded H5 panel used in the completed ES confirmation, 1448 days through 2026-07-23
source_policy.inference_and_accounts: Same frozen Nov3 provider, formal annual DK_I and fixed-s5 account inputs

H20_bridge.reuse: Reuse confirmed H20 p50 only if ordered training indices and both float64 ranked labels and actual float32 model labels are exact against the frozen original cache; features, weights and validation must be identical.
H20_bridge.otherwise: Fit H20 first under the uniform new labels, derive prespecified p20 prefixes without extra fitting, evaluate both and run fixed-s5 before the other six H.
H20_bridge.readiness: If re-fitted: all p50 naturally stop within200 and select >6; no boundary ties at selected rounds; reverse-priority stopping choices agree; p50 model net_ann/net_sharpe and s5 CAGR/Sharpe are no lower than paired p20 (tolerance1e-12); no ensemble collapse below every component. If these fail, stop H expansion and preserve the bridge finding.

evaluation.official: Five-seed daily zscore equal-weight ensemble; Top3xH5 net_ann/net_ann_vol/net_sharpe and global H5 RankIC; same yearly/style definitions
evaluation.account: Fixed s5 top5/drop1/hold1/f100,risk.90,1m,original fees; CAGR/Sharpe/drawdown/Alpha/Beta/benchmark; no strategy tuning

interpretation.T: Report all adjacent nonnegative differences in increasing H, separately net_ann and Sharpe; distinguish strict trend from H40 endpoint maximum.
interpretation.D: Report all adjacent nonpositive differences in increasing H>=5, separately return and Sharpe; distinguish monotonicity from H5 maximum.
interpretation.F: All tied maximizing H should lie in {5,7,10} to fully support the proposed peak interval; list every tie.
interpretation.secondary: Report Spearman H-vs-metric descriptively, yearly consistency, and fixed-s5 pattern agreement. Do not redefine a hypothesis after seeing results.
interpretation.F_limitation: F occurs only in seven months of 2024 (136 days); no cross-year confirmation or live style switching claim.
interpretation.exposure: historical_selection_window; not independent out-of-sample; no promotion

entry_policy: One model study entry contains all seven internal arms and failures. H20 is the prespecified representative/control for the existing report interface, never a claimed winner. One derived fixed-s5 validation entry links the full seven-arm report.
constraints: Do not silently substitute current live data for frozen inputs
